full_name: Chiara Zurzolo | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: During her time at Radcliffe, Chiara Zurzolo is teaming up with neuroscientists and developmental biologists at Harvard to use a range of innovative imaging techniques in investigating the existence and relevance of TNT structures in vivo. They hope to understand whether there are opportunities for therapeutical intervention.
